text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before the race, Biko Pegasus pumped 
himself up by getting into character as a 
tokusatsu hero.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The opponent is Sakura Bakushin O, who has 
reigned supreme over the sprint division 
with overwhelming power. She might be 
outmatched in both strength and 
popularity.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even so, he never gives up. Biko Pegasus 
declared that, just like Carrotman, he 
would stand up to any opponent.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The venue's excitement hits fever pitch 
for this cross-generational clash. The 
curtain rises on the decisive battle that 
will divine the future of the sprint 
division!
